title: Rho header
description: A full-width 72px bar stuck to the top: a large wordmark, four plain nav links beside it, and on the right two text links and a mint button. On phones the wordmark and a menu icon open a simple dropdown list. Its colours follow the page's tone.
notes: tone="dark" by default (sits over the dark hero); inside rho-tone-flow it follows the page
the phone menu is a native <details> dropdown: no JavaScript
name: rho-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, set as a wordmark

props.name: links
props.description: main navigation, beside the wordmark on desktop

props.name: secondary
props.description: quiet text links on the right (sign in, demo)

props.name: cta
props.description: the mint button on the right

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the phone menu button

props.name: tone
props.description: dark or light bar (inside rho-tone-flow it follows the page instead)
